title: 第一千六百一十七章 安置第一千六百一十六章 北冥仙岛
content_zh:
送走青儿、萍儿与宋坤三人后，刘长旭转身走向那处洞府。
洞口不算大，高不过丈许，隐在苍翠草木间，看上去平平无奇。只是洞口表面萦绕着一层淡淡的白色禁制，微光流转，散发着令人心悸的气息。
刘长旭取出洞府令牌，令牌上的符文与禁制气息相触的刹那，那层白色禁制便化为无数光点彻底消散，露出了幽深的通道。
他抬步跨过洞口，脚下的景象却骤然一变，呈现在他眼前的，竟是一处精致秀雅的庄园。
庄园内，楼阁林立，亭台错落，草木葱茏，仙泉喷涌，空气中弥漫着浓郁而温润的仙气。
见此情景，刘长旭眼中闪过一丝惊讶，随即了然，这洞府显然是一处小型秘境空间，难怪能在山腹之中藏下这般景致。
不过这处空间虽说还算不错，但根本与刘长旭的如意莲花碟相比。
他对庄园扫视了两眼，便失了探究的兴致，身形一晃便踏入了如意莲花碟内。
刚一进入，妻子黄玉蔷、黄玉薇、慕容月三女，连同儿子刘福宝、刘福舟、刘福连便围了上来，眼中满是关切。
“夫君，外面战局如何了？”
黄玉蔷率先开口，语气中带着一丝不易察觉的紧张。
刘长旭神色平静地回道：
“眼下人族暂处下风，已退守北冥仙岛。好在有护岛大阵庇佑，在安全上暂时无虞。”
“爹，您什么时候带我们出去杀妖？”
性子最是好战的刘福连按捺不住，凑上前问道：
刘长旭看了儿子一眼，当即沉声训斥道：
“何时出战，为父自有安排。你眼下最该做的，是老老实实潜心修炼，莫要心浮气躁。”
“是，爹。”
刘福连见父亲语气严肃，不敢再争辩，连忙应道：
刘长旭转向众人，语气郑重的说道：

“这段时日，你们且在如意莲花碟中安心修炼。待时机成熟，我自会安排你们出战。”
他心中清楚，此前战局对人族不利，连自身安危都难完全保证，自然不敢让妻儿们涉险。
毕竟一旦投入战场，面对全面占优的妖族强者，他根本无法分心照顾妻儿。而在那般混乱的局势下，稍有不慎便可能造成无法挽回的伤亡。
如果妻子儿女们在战场上有个三长两短，他后悔都来不及。因此，他方才极力压制儿女们上战场的冲动。
刘长旭见在场的妻儿都没有意见，便继续说道：
“好了，今天咱们一家先一起吃个饭，其他的事，以后再说！”
黄玉蔷得知夫君提议一家人聚餐，赶紧应道：
“夫君，我这就去安排！”
“好了！咱们一家一起做吧！我今天也给你们露一手！”
刘长旭笑呵呵的说道：
于是，一家人便进入厨房中开始忙碌起来。
刘长旭进入厨房后，便从储物镯中取出一块被他斩杀的虎肉，开始忙碌起来。
content_en:
After seeing off Qing'er, Ping'er and Song Kun, Liu Changxu turned around and walked towards the cave.
The entrance of the cave is not big, only about ten feet high. It is hidden among the green vegetation and looks ordinary. There is just a layer of faint white prohibition lingering on the surface of the cave entrance, and the faint light flows, exuding a heart-stopping aura.
Liu Changxu took out the cave token. The moment the runes on the token came into contact with the forbidden aura, the layer of white restrictions turned into countless light spots and completely dissipated, revealing the deep passage.
He stepped across the cave entrance, and the scene under his feet suddenly changed. What appeared in front of him was an exquisite and elegant manor.
In the manor, there are many pavilions and pavilions, lush vegetation, gushing fairy springs, and the air is filled with a rich and warm fairy spirit.
Seeing this scene, Liu Changxu's eyes flashed with surprise, and he immediately understood that this cave was obviously a small secret space. No wonder it could hide such a scenery in the heart of the mountain.
However, although this space is not bad, it is not comparable to Liu Changxu's Ruyi Lotus Disk.
He glanced at the manor twice, then lost interest in exploring, and stepped into the wishful lotus dish in a flash.
As soon as they entered, their wives Huang Yuqiang, Huang Yuwei, and Murong Yue, as well as their sons Liu Fubao, Liu Fuzhou, and Liu Fulian, gathered around him, their eyes full of concern.
"Husband, how is the war situation outside?"
Huang Yuqiang was the first to speak, with a hint of unnoticeable nervousness in her tone.
Liu Changxu replied calmly:
"Right now, the human race is at a disadvantage and has retreated to the Beiming Immortal Island. Fortunately, there is a large formation protecting the island, so there is no danger of safety for the time being."
"Dad, when will you take us out to kill monsters?"
Liu Fulian, who had the most bellicose temperament, couldn't hold himself back and stepped forward and asked:
Liu Changxu glanced at his son and immediately scolded him in a deep voice:
"My father has his own arrangements for when to go to war. The most important thing for you to do now is to concentrate on training honestly and don't be impetuous."
"Yes, Dad."
Seeing his father's serious tone, Liu Fulian did not dare to argue anymore and quickly responded:
Liu Changxu turned to everyone and said solemnly:
"During this period, you can practice peacefully in the Ruyi Lotus Disk. When the time is right, I will arrange for you to go into battle."
He knew in his heart that the previous war situation was not good for the human race, and even his own safety could not be completely guaranteed, so naturally he did not dare to put his wife and children in danger.
After all, once he enters the battlefield and faces the powerful monsters who are completely dominant, he simply cannot distract himself from taking care of his wife and children. In such a chaotic situation, a little carelessness may cause irreparable casualties.
If his wife and children were in trouble on the battlefield, it would be too late for him to regret it. Therefore, he just tried his best to suppress his children's impulse to go to the battlefield.
Seeing that his wife and children present had no objections, Liu Changxu continued:
"Okay, let's have a meal together as a family today, and we'll talk about other things later!"
When Huang Yuqiang learned that her husband proposed a family dinner, she quickly responded:
"Husband, I will make arrangements right away!"
"Okay! Let's do it together as a family! I will also show you my skills today!"
Liu Changxu said with a smile:
So, the family entered the kitchen and started getting busy.
After Liu Changxu entered the kitchen, he took out a piece of tiger meat that he had killed from the storage bracelet and started to get busy.
